tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the store guides, articles and policy pages (Hebrew). Use when the user asks how to choose, replace or maintain a water filter, UV lamp or descaling kit, or asks about shipping, returns or warranty. Returns titles, excerpts and URLs; follow with get_guide for the full text.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read the full text of one guide, article or policy page as markdown. Use after search_guides when the excerpt is not enough to answer.

tools.name: list_faq
tools.description: List the questions and answers published for a product category (for example Tami 4 filters or UV lamps). Use when the user wants quick answers about a product family rather than one product.
